summary:
The most active week on this account since 2026-08-21 and the first genuine two-way one in months: 29 messages, 10 from Hailey, 19 from ALTR, plus a second silent group add. She opened the window herself on 9/13 with the single most important message she has ever sent this chat - 'Hey guys I know revenue this month is down so what do you guys need from me to help boost this months sale'. She is the one who noticed revenue was falling, and she is the one who asked what ALTR needed. Mayson's answer was 19 seconds later and was one character of content: '@natehei ^'. Noah has still not replied, five days on - the second time this year Mayson has tagged @natehei on one of her escalations and got silence (8/18 was the first). Ronnie did answer, two hours later, with two real levers - private lives and lowered custom prices - she said 'Yes i can do private lives' the next morning, and the entire follow-up since is the word 'Awesome'. Nothing has been scheduled. The one moment where this client volunteered new revenue for ALTR has been sitting idle for four days.

Responsiveness genuinely improved, and that has to be said plainly after three periods of the opposite. Her sextpanther question was answered in 50 minutes. Stephski held a real, warm, late-night back-and-forth with her on 9/16 that ran half an hour and included actual laughter on both sides - the first human conversation on this account in months. She paid the Sep 1-14 invoice the day after it was issued, with no nudge at all, cycle 27 of 27, her fastest turnaround since 4/15. The pre-invoice OF-withdrawal reminder habit, which lapsed before the 9/1 invoice, was restored on 9/14. Mica sent an unprompted Instagram security advisory on 9/17 that lands squarely on her number-one priority and correctly tells her not to share backup codes with anyone including ALTR.

And underneath all of that, the banking situation got worse for the third cycle running. The 9/15 invoice came with 'Please note a slight name change to the account, but the same account and wire info' and then, eleven minutes later, 'Noting its very important that you send to this bank account vs the one you sent to last period' - which supersedes the account she wired to on 9/7 on ALTR's own written instruction. Three consecutive cycles have now gone to three different targets (8/20 last month's account on Derrek's verbal say-so, 9/7 the 9/1 invoice account, 9/16 the renamed account) and ALTR has confirmed receipt of NONE of them. On 9/16 she asked in the plainest possible words - 'Wire was sent to the new banking info! Please let me know if you recieved it' - and the answer she got 108 minutes later was 'Appreciate you ❤️'. That is the same non-answer she got on 9/6, and it is the fourth time she has had to ask for a receipt (6/4, 6/16, 7/9, 9/16). Stephski's own words in the same exchange: 'everything should go through this time (i pray)'. Hers: 'I just nicknamed it September because i have too many wire recipients and i get confused' and 'these wires got me stressed 😂'. That is the first time she has described ALTR's banking churn as stress rather than logistics.

The sharpest single juxtaposition of the week: on 9/16 and 9/17 Mayson asked her for a Facebook account and then for its login - 'Are you able to share us the login info so we can start posting Haleigh' - while the Instagram login Vivek asked for on 7/29, to investigate the shadowban that is her loudest complaint, has gone un-chased for 51 days. ALTR will ask this client for credentials when ALTR wants something. It will not ask for credentials to fix her problem. She was live in this chat on five separate days and nobody raised it. Vivek posted nothing again; he has now posted one message in 808. Derrek posted nothing again - 48 days since his own 8/1 promise of 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the $40k phone farm.

Everything else simply aged. The .vip domains that restricted two of her IG accounts: 97 days, and Mayson posted three times this window without mentioning them once. His own 8/27 question about why she isn't using them is 22 days unanswered. The 8/30 content Drive with its 7-reels-a-week quota: 19 days, still zero uploads, and this week nobody chased it at all because Michelle posted nothing - which also means her weekly leak-removal recap, the one deliverable on this account with an unbroken record, has now gone 10 days without landing. Named account manager: 180 days, and a SECOND person was silently added to the group at 22:46 on 9/17, eight days after the first, neither of whom has spoken.

health.rationale: First increase in seven reporting periods (80 -> 68 -> 65 -> 58 -> 54 -> 51 -> 56), and it is earned rather than noise. Three things reversed at once. She re-engaged proactively and on value, not on billing - 'what do you guys need from me to help boost this months sale' is the opposite of last period's read that she had narrowed the relationship to the invoice. ALTR actually answered her inside hours for the first time in three periods (Ronnie 2h on revenue, 50 minutes on sextpanther) and Stephski held a genuinely warm half-hour conversation with her at 23:27 on 9/16. And she paid in one day with no nudge at all, cycle 27 of 27, her fastest since April. The score is capped at 56 rather than higher for four reasons. First, revenue is down and SHE reported it - ALTR has published no performance or revenue figure into this chat in 2026; the only recurring numbers she receives are leak-takedown counts. Second, banking got worse again: a third destination in three cycles, three unconfirmed wires, her explicit 'Please let me know if you recieved it' answered with 'Appreciate you ❤️', and ALTR's own invoicing lead writing 'everything should go through this time (i pray)'. Third, the one new revenue lever she volunteered for - private lives - has been left unscheduled since 9/14 and her revenue question was routed to @natehei, who never replied. Fourth, every structural item aged another week untouched while ALTR asked her for a Facebook login: .vip domains 97 days, shadowban 51, Derrek's own promise 48, named AM 180, content consolidation 218.

The follow-up is the finding: 'send to this bank account vs the one you sent to last period' explicitly supersedes the account ALTR's own 9/1 invoice told her to use on 9/7.
